name: SmokeApprovalGates
title: Smoke — PAT-249 approval gates + four-eyes
description: Raw draft MeasureDefinition (POST /api/measures). One test case with a wrong expectation must block submit-for-review (409 Measure Not Ready); once fixed, submit succeeds, the owner's own approve is refused (403 Approval Not Allowed) and the shared reviewer's approve lands the measure active.
cqlContent:
library SmokeApprovalGates version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18
